messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: route-runtime-us-east-1 high request rate spike (soft throttle). No error rate increase reported.
PagerDuty: Pager escalated to OnCall (page id PDX-8241) — please ack.
Marie O.: acked. I'm on it.
Sam R.: thx. any initial signal from metrics?
Marie O.: looking — router qps jumped ~3x around 09:12 UTC, 95th latency +120ms. CPU on proxy pool hit 86% but not OOM. No 5xx flood.
Lee P.: could be synthetic canary overlap + a downstream prefill job. tagging infra to check scheduling.
Alex I.: seeing a flurry of warmup jobs from tenant-id 88f4, repeated prefill requests every ~6s. stack snippet: `prefill_task.create(tenant=88f4, seq=1..N)`
Marie O.: can we temporarily mute that tenant? if it's noisy it will keep firing autoscale.
Sam R.: agree, add a soft suppress on route-runtime-us-east-1 for tenant 88f4 for 10m while we investigate. I'll push a suppression patch.
Marie O.: suppression applied (10m). monitoring results: qps dropping back to baseline within 2m.
Lee P.: rolling window logs show the prefill loop originated from an internal test runner (ci-sim) in us-east. Devtools alerted earlier but rate pattern looked normal until today.
Alex I.: I'll add a short debounce on the prefill worker to avoid burst retries. patch queued.
Marie O.: good. customer impact check: no user-facing errors, only slightly higher latency for a 90s window. Noticing a handful of requests hit fallback model (lower-cost variant) for ~30s.
Sam R.: note for postmortem: add tenant-level rate guard + incidentbot rule to detect repeating prefill loops.
PagerDuty: Pager PDX-8241 auto-resolved (no escalation actions required).
Marie O.: closing handoff — leaving note to follow up with CI team.
Lee P.: leaving a JIRA: INF-4372 'prevent runaway prefill loops' and assigning to devtools.
Alex I.: will cherry-pick debounce into canary today.
Marie O.: thanks all :thumbsup: marking this thread resolved.
Sam R.: recommend reducing suppression window to 5m in future to avoid masking real regressions — added to infra backlog.
Marie O.: noted. end.
